question: Could you tell me the first names of customers who spent less than $1 on albums by the best-selling artist, along with the amounts they spent?
sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) AS AmountSpent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items oi ON i.InvoiceId = oi.InvoiceId
JOIN tracks t ON oi.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
WHERE a.ArtistId = 90
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) < 1.0
ORDER BY AmountSpent
